reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Oregon
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does a public emergency require postponement of the execution of a writ of eviction?

    Source statute encoded:
      [1] OR Rev Stat  105.159 (2021)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(oregon).
focus_year(2021).

% Factual statement: a public emergency exists (type left generic).
public_emergency_declared(oregon, public_emergency).

% Factual statement: there is an eviction writ whose execution is pending/scheduled.
eviction_case(case1).
writ_of_restitution_or_eviction(case1).
execution_of_writ_pending(case1).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the scenario's factual statement holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(oregon),
    focus_year(2021),
    public_emergency_declared(oregon, public_emergency),
    eviction_case(case1),
    writ_of_restitution_or_eviction(case1),
    execution_of_writ_pending(case1).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic calendar helpers (self-contained, integer "Day" timeline)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Day-of-week mapping using Day mod 7, where Day=0 is Monday.
dow_from_index(0, mon).
dow_from_index(1, tue).
dow_from_index(2, wed).
dow_from_index(3, thu).
dow_from_index(4, fri).
dow_from_index(5, sat).
dow_from_index(6, sun).

day_of_week(Day, Dow) :-
    integer(Day),
    Index is Day mod 7,
    dow_from_index(Index, Dow).

is_weekend(Day) :-
    day_of_week(Day, sat),
    !.
is_weekend(Day) :-
    day_of_week(Day, sun).

% Legal holidays are not specified in the question; keep an explicit predicate.
% (No holidays asserted for the scenario.)
legal_holiday(_Day) :- fail.

judicial_day(Day) :-
    integer(Day),
    \+ is_weekend(Day),
    \+ legal_holiday(Day).

next_judicial_day_after(Day, NextJudicialDay) :-
    integer(Day),
    Day1 is Day + 1,
    (   judicial_day(Day1)
    ->  NextJudicialDay = Day1
    ;   next_judicial_day_after(Day1, NextJudicialDay)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute encoding: OR Rev Stat  105.159 (2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  ORS 105.159(1)(a): four-day period commences at 12:01 a.m. on the day after
  mailing/service (including weekend/holiday). We model the "commence day"
  as StartDay = MailServiceDay + 1.
*/
statute_ors_105_159_period_start_day(MailServiceDay, StartDay) :-
    integer(MailServiceDay),
    StartDay is MailServiceDay + 1.

/*
  ORS 105.159(1)(b): ends at 11:59 p.m. on the fourth calendar day after mailing/service,
  except if the fourth day is Sat/Sun/holiday, it ends at 11:59 p.m. on the day
  preceding the next judicial day.

  We model the "end day" as an integer EndDay.
*/
statute_ors_105_159_period_end_day(MailServiceDay, EndDay) :-
    integer(MailServiceDay),
    CandidateEndDay is MailServiceDay + 4,
    (   judicial_day(CandidateEndDay)
    ->  EndDay = CandidateEndDay
    ;   next_judicial_day_after(CandidateEndDay, NextJudicialDay),
        EndDay is NextJudicialDay - 1
    ).

/* Convenience: full four-day period window. */
statute_ors_105_159_four_day_period(MailServiceDay, StartDay, EndDay) :-
    statute_ors_105_159_period_start_day(MailServiceDay, StartDay),
    statute_ors_105_159_period_end_day(MailServiceDay, EndDay).

/*
  ORS 105.159(2): after expiration of the period in the notice of restitution,
  plaintiff may request clerk issue writ.

  We interpret "after expiration" as RequestDay > EndDay.
*/
statute_ors_105_159_request_after_expiration(MailServiceDay, RequestDay) :-
    integer(MailServiceDay),
    integer(RequestDay),
    statute_ors_105_159_period_end_day(MailServiceDay, EndDay),
    RequestDay > EndDay.

/*
  ORS 105.159(3): unless judgment otherwise provides, clerk may not issue notice/writ
  more than 60 days after judgment entered OR after any possession date specified,
  whichever is later.

  We model later-of(JudgmentDay, PossessionDay) and require RequestDay - Later =< 60.
*/
statute_ors_105_159_within_60_days_of_later(JudgmentDay, PossessionDay, RequestDay) :-
    integer(JudgmentDay),
    integer(PossessionDay),
    integer(RequestDay),
    (   JudgmentDay >= PossessionDay
    ->  Later is JudgmentDay
    ;   Later is PossessionDay
    ),
    Delta is RequestDay - Later,
    Delta =< 60.

/*
  Combined permission to issue writ under ORS 105.159(2)-(3),
  ignoring fee payment and "judgment otherwise provides" exceptions (not in facts).
*/
statute_ors_105_159_clerk_may_issue_writ(MailServiceDay, JudgmentDay, PossessionDay, RequestDay) :-
    statute_ors_105_159_request_after_expiration(MailServiceDay, RequestDay),
    statute_ors_105_159_within_60_days_of_later(JudgmentDay, PossessionDay, RequestDay).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: Does a public emergency require postponement of writ execution?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  The statute provided (ORS 105.159) regulates timing for the restitution notice period
  and the clerk's issuance window. It does not create any rule that a "public emergency"
  requires postponing the execution/enforcement of a writ.

  We represent "statutory postponement triggers" explicitly. Because ORS 105.159 contains
  no emergency-based postponement trigger, this predicate has no successful cases.
*/
statutory_postponement_trigger(_Trigger) :-
    fail.

/* Postponement due to public emergency would require an emergency-based trigger. */
postponement_required_due_to_public_emergency :-
    public_emergency_declared(_State, _Type),
    statutory_postponement_trigger(public_emergency).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    postponement_required_due_to_public_emergency,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does a public emergency require postponement of the execution of a write of eviction?
